data_facts_with_vis_data_meta.paragraph: In 2016, 27.5% of the global adult population and 81% of adolescents failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise. Physical inactivity was responsible for 13.4 million disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) worldwide. Healthcare professionals should try to implement PA as a general treatment, as any type of PA yields positive effects on an individual’s cardiovascular health, contributing to a 27% reduction in relative risk of cardiovascular mortality.

facts.fact_content: 27.5% of the global adult population failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise in 2016.
81% of adolescents failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise in 2016.
Physical inactivity was responsible for 13.4 million disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) worldwide.
27% reduction in relative risk of cardiovascular mortality due to physical activity.

data_facts_with_vis_data_meta.paragraph: PA and increasing one’s daily step count to 6,500 steps/day are associated with a reduced relative risk of CVD-related mortality of 49% [2], as well as a reduced incidence of CVD itself [3].

facts.fact_content: Increasing daily step count to 6,500 steps/day is associated with a reduced relative risk of CVD-related mortality of 49%.
